hints: Mark a vertex visited when you POP it, not when you push it - a vertex can sit in the stack several times and only the first pop counts.
Because of that, check 'if (visited[u]) continue;' right after popping.
To match recursive order, push neighbours in DESCENDING order so the smallest is on top and comes off first.
source: DSA Lab Week 3 - Graphs requires DFS to be ITERATIVE using the STACK ADT
title: DFS with an explicit stack
